reference.opaqueBatching: public InstancedMesh groups for repeated geometry/material pairs

toneMapping: none; linear light encoded once into LDR sRGB

shadow.filter: nearest comparison, square uniform PCF; one or nine taps
shadow.refresh: regenerated each submitted frame; frames are paced through RAF outside CPU timing

environment.layout: linear RGBA float32; top row +Y; longitude atan2(z,x)/(2*pi)+0.5

particles.geometry: unit mesh-local XZ quad with +Y normal; billboard basis right/toward-camera/minus-up
particles.sorting: within each emitter by descending view depth; emitters by mean view depth; before translucent entities

visualGate.scope: whole foreground, declared object rectangles and independently projected particle pixels; no image alignment or fitted colour transform
visualGate.particleStructure: indexed quad instance totals must equal independently simulated particles plus emitter markers

measurement.gpu: sum of every render and compute pass across all frame encoders, plus first-to-last timestamp span; copies before/after passes are not covered by pass sums; missing timestamps invalidate GPU timing
measurement.cpu: synchronous frame preparation/submission, completion awaited outside interval; no per-draw counter or timestamp wrappers
measurement.presented: visible native canvas; PresentMon 2.6.0 ETW displayed-frame timestamps filtered to the isolated browser GPU process and one unambiguous swapchain; RAF intervals recorded separately; no per-frame GPU completion wait
measurement.performanceEligibility: complete current hardware visual/structure/lifetime matrix, exact built-package and measurement-source identity, all 240 scheduled passes accepted across three repeats; real hardware adapter and observable quiet CPU/external GPU; native visible-canvas consistency; ETW capture with no reported lost events or ambiguous swapchains. Software comparison failures are retained separately.
measurement.order: rotate workload/profile and pass order across repeats; alternate engine order for each pair; one fresh browser context per pass; serial GPU use
measurement.memory: steady logical GPU descriptor bytes in counter pass; native allocations remaining after device destruction are not inferred from residual JavaScript handles; no instrument-contaminated JS heap comparison

nativeConsistency.scope: same-engine native canvas screenshot against its offscreen reference at the matching fixed simulation frame; no alignment or fitted transform

regressions.scope: compare qualified runs with the same workload/assets/reference/measurement definition and physical environment; baseline values come only from a complete qualified run

measurement.browserColourProfile: --force-color-profile=srgb for both engines and every pass; no OS profile changes or fitted pixel transform
measurement.referenceOutput: Native Three linear UnsignedByte output buffer and output colour-conversion pass in both native and readback modes, through public setOutputRenderTarget; no custom BRDF or fitted output transform
